Remark
[Laplacian of an inner product of Killing fields]

Source: petersen:page-0344 ↗ def:pet-ch8-killing-field 1. ch8:8.4.11Given two Killing fields $X,Y$ on a Riemannian manifold, develop a formula for $\Delta g(X,Y)$. Use this to give a formula for the Ricci curvature in a frame consisting of Killing fields.
